'''Anjiliac Tower''' was a skytower<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was used by the [[Anjiliac]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TF" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Anjiliac leader [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]] held a banquet in [[Popara's penthouse|his penthouse]] atop the tower. Popara was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] during the event<ref name="TF" /> and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]], who had been among Popara's guests, were falsely accused of the crime and forced to flee the tower.<ref name="Scourge" />
